cards.ex: The bank is offering a competitive interest rate on their savings accounts.
cards.exUz: Bank o'z jamg'arma hisoblariga raqobatbardosh foiz stavkasini taklif qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qarz yoki depozit uchun to'lanadigan foiz miqdori, yillik foizda ifodalanadi.

cards.ex: The 2008 credit crunch had a devastating impact on the global economy.
cards.exUz: 2008-yildagi kredit tanqisligi global iqtisodiyotga halokatli ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Banklar va boshqa moliyaviy muassasalar kredit berishni keskin qisqartirganda yuzaga keladigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: It's good to keep some liquid assets in case of emergencies.
cards.exUz: Favqulodda vaziyatlar uchun bir oz likvid aktivlarni saqlab turish yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda naqd pulga aylantirilishi mumkin bo'lgan aktivlar, masalan, aksiyalar yoki obligatsiyalar.

cards.ex: Investors are worried we're entering a bear market.
cards.exUz: Investorlar biz ayiq bozoriga kirayotganimizdan xavotirda.
cards.uzDef: Aksiyalar narxi uzoq vaqt davomida pasayib boradigan bozor.

cards.ex: The bull market has been going strong for over a decade.
cards.exUz: Buqa bozori o'n yildan ortiq vaqt davomida kuchli bo'lib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Aksiyalar narxi uzoq vaqt davomida ko'tarilib boradigan bozor.

cards.ex: The government's fiscal policy aims to stimulate economic growth.
cards.exUz: Hukumatning fiskal siyosati iqtisodiy o'sishni rag'batlantirishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Hukumatning iqtisodiyotga ta'sir qilish uchun soliq va xarajatlardan foydalanish siyosati.

cards.ex: The central bank uses monetary policy to control inflation.
cards.exUz: Markaziy bank inflyatsiyani nazorat qilish uchun pul-kredit siyosatidan foydalanadi.
cards.uzDef: Markaziy bankning pul massasini va kredit sharoitlarini boshqarish siyosati.

cards.ex: He made his fortune working for a hedge fund.
cards.exUz: U xedj fondda ishlash orqali boylik orttirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori daromad olishga qaratilgan, xavfli investitsiya strategiyalarini qo'llaydigan investitsiya fondi.

cards.ex: Mortgage rates are currently at an all-time low.
cards.exUz: Ipoteka foizlari hozirda eng past darajada.
cards.uzDef: Uy sotib olish uchun berilgan kredit uchun to'lanadigan foiz.

cards.ex: Compound interest is the key to long-term wealth accumulation.
cards.exUz: Murakkab foiz uzoq muddatli boylik to'plashning kalitidir.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy summadan ham, oldingi davrlarda olingan foizdan ham hisoblanadigan foiz.

cards.ex: The country is at risk of defaulting on its debt.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat qarzni to'lay olmaslik xavfi ostida.
cards.uzDef: Qarzni shartnomaga muvofiq to'lay olmaslik.

cards.ex: A good credit rating is essential for getting a loan.
cards.exUz: Kredit olish uchun yaxshi kredit reytingi muhim.
cards.uzDef: Qarz oluvchining kreditga layoqatini baholash.

cards.ex: The government is trying to keep the inflation rate under control.
cards.exUz: Hukumat inflyatsiya darajasini nazorat ostida ushlab turishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tovar va xizmatlar narxlarining umumiy darajasining oshishi sur'ati.

cards.ex: The stock market is very volatile right now.
cards.exUz: Fond bozori hozir juda o'zgaruvchan.
cards.uzDef: Aksiyalar va boshqa qimmatli qog'ozlar sotiladigan bozor.

cards.ex: The prime rate has been raised by 0.25%.
cards.exUz: Asosiy stavka 0,25% ga oshirildi.
cards.uzDef: Banklar o'z mijozlariga eng kamida beradigan foiz stavkasi.

cards.ex: The company's balance sheet looks very healthy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning balans hisoboti juda sog'lom ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning aktivlari, majburiyatlari va kapitalini ko'rsatuvchi moliyaviy hisobot.

cards.ex: The bottom line is that we need to cut costs.
cards.exUz: Muhimi, biz xarajatlarni qisqartirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Daromadlar va xarajatlar hisobga olingandan keyingi yakuniy foyda.

cards.ex: The company needs to improve its cash flow management.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya pul oqimini boshqarishni yaxshilashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaga kirayotgan va chiqayotgan pul miqdori.

cards.ex: The depreciation expense is a significant deduction.
cards.exUz: Amortizatsiya xarajatlari muhim chegirma hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Aktiv qiymatining vaqt o'tishi bilan kamayishi.

cards.ex: The company had to write down the value of its assets.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'z aktivlarining qiymatini pasaytirishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Aktivning balansdagi qiymatini kamaytirish.

cards.ex: The company uses a tax haven to minimize its tax liability.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya soliq majburiyatlarini kamaytirish uchun soliq jannatidan foydalanadi.
cards.uzDef: Soliqlarning pastligi yoki yo'qligi bilan ajralib turadigan davlat yoki hudud.

cards.ex: The country narrowly avoided the fiscal cliff.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat fiskal jarlikdan arang qutuldi.
cards.uzDef: Soliq imtiyozlari tugashi va xarajatlar kamayganda yuzaga keladigan iqtisodiy vaziyat.

cards.ex: He was arrested for inside trading.
cards.exUz: U insayder savdosi uchun hibsga olingan.
cards.uzDef: Maxfiy ma'lumotlardan foydalanib qimmatli qog'ozlar bilan savdo qilish.

cards.ex: Loose monetary policy can inflate the bubble.
cards.exUz: Erkin pul-kredit siyosati pufakni shishirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Aktivlar narxining asossiz ravishda oshib ketishiga sabab bo'lish.

cards.ex: They tried to corner the market in silver.
cards.exUz: Ular kumush bozorini egallashga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Tovarning yoki aktivning ta'minotini nazorat qilish orqali narxni belgilash.

cards.ex: I had to jump through hoops to get the loan approved.
cards.exUz: Kreditni tasdiqlash uchun ko'p to'siqlardan o'tishimga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga erishish uchun ko'p qiyinchiliklarni yengib o'tish.

cards.ex: I had to put up my house as collateral for the loan.
cards.exUz: Kredit uchun uyimni garovga qo'yishimga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Kreditni ta'minlash uchun garov sifatida aktiv qo'yish.

cards.ex: It's better to cut your losses than to keep throwing good money after bad.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi pulni yomon pulga tashlashdan ko'ra, zararni kamaytirgan yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Zararli vaziyatdan chiqib ketish, zararni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: It's important to diversify your portfolio to reduce risk.
cards.exUz: Xavfni kamaytirish uchun portfelni diversifikatsiya qilish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni kamaytirish uchun turli aktivlarga sarmoya kiritish.

cards.ex: Small businesses will bear the brunt of the economic downturn.
cards.exUz: Kichik bizneslar iqtisodiy pasayishning eng yomon ta'sirini his qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning eng yomon ta'sirini his qilish.
